Level_1_Narrative_Desc: Data thieves are targeting members of the public. There's no extortion, no threats. It's just a bit of fun.
It's not like the victims lives are being completely ruined…
This is the long description for Level 2. There is an indication that the hacking is more serious than you first thought.
This is the long description for Level 3. It is clear that the hackers are targeting larger organisations
This is the long description for Level 4. We now know that the hackers are attacking human memories via implants.
This is the long description for Level 5. No one is safe. No government. No individual.
